description: Provider decision for one Fetch whose envelope has passed envelope/v0 verification. Input {"provider": {"node", "agents"}, "connectionPeer": wwn, "bindings": {wwa: wwn} (agent-certs the provider holds), "envelope": {"from", "to", "ts", "exp", "cap"?: {"capability"?}, "body"}, "authorization": "allow" or the error of the capability/v0 token checks (CAP-160 steps 1-7 and 9; the operation and resource check of step 8 is part of this kind), "store": {hash: {"size", "blocks"?}} (absent blocks = whole blob)}. Output {"hash", "size", "ranges"} of the reply. Identifiers are syntactically valid test values, not real keys.

cases.description: A range past the end gets the last block
Partial copy with its last block: sends what it has
Partial copy, none of the requested blocks: empty reply
Partial copy without its last block is not served
Denied, blob not held: same answer (no existence oracle)
Long-lived token without a fresh revocation list
to is not an agent of this node
from is bound to another node than the connection's peer
from has no agent-cert at the provider
Invalid token and a capability for another blob: the token check comes first (CAP-160)
TTL too long and relayed: the TTL check comes first
Invalid body and denied token: the body check comes first
